audit_basis.semantic_inclusion_rule: The symbol body itself changes metric extraction, selection, classification, applicability, value, or status.
audit_basis.shared_plumbing_rule: Persistence, transport, orchestration, and invariant checking without an owned metric decision are not semantic producers.

disposition_definitions.ALIASED_TO::<producer_id>: The parent name is rebound; the named runtime producer owns the remaining scope.
disposition_definitions.EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON: The symbol is outside this granularity only with explicit per-record evidence.
disposition_definitions.INCLUDED_AS_SEMANTIC_PRODUCER: The same file::symbol is in the frozen semantic producer set.
disposition_definitions.INVARIANT_NOT_PRODUCER: The symbol checks outputs but does not produce metric semantics.
disposition_definitions.OBSOLETE_WITH_PROOF: The historical configuration is retained only as parent migration evidence.
disposition_definitions.RECLASSIFIED_AS_SHARED_PLUMBING: The symbol persists or orchestrates data but owns no metric decision.
